title: NBA: SGA, Thunder hungry for more after downing Spurs

blocks.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander said the Oklahoma City Thunder are “hungry” for more success after exacting a small measure of revenge on the San Antonio Spurs in their NBA season-opener on Tuesday. Gilgeous-Alexander launched his account for the 2026-2027 campaign with a 32-point display as Oklahoma City scored a 116-104 win on the road over the team that eliminated the 2025 champions from last season’s playoffs. The reigning NBA Most Valuable Player admitted though, that simply being back on the court was more important for a Thunder team determined to reclaim their crown. “Obviously this is the team that eliminated us from achieving […]...
